description: HUD icons for the broadcast viewer: weapon and equipment silhouettes in the kill feed and player panels. Original designs, not copies of any real game's icons.
style: Clean flat white silhouette icon on a fully transparent background, side view, crisp edges, subtle inner detail lines, no outline glow, centred and filling most of the width, consistent visual weight as part of one esports broadcast HUD icon set. Original stylised design inspired by real-world firearms, not a copy of any specific product or game asset. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
